# OPNsense DHCPv4 Lease Widget

[![maintenance-status](https://img.shields.io/badge/maintenance-as--is-yellow.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://gist.github.com/angelside/364976fbcf7001a5da7e79ad8ed91fec)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPLv3-green?style=for-the-badge&logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,)](./LICENSE)

> DHCP Leases list widget for opnsense 24.7+

## 📦 Installation

- Open an `ssh` session and run the commands below:

```bash
fetch -o /usr/local/opnsense/www/js/widgets/Leases.js https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angelside/opnsense-dhcp-widget/refs/heads/develop/Leases.js
```
```bash
fetch -o /usr/local/opnsense/www/js/widgets/Metadata/Leases.xml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angelside/opnsense-dhcp-widget/refs/heads/develop/Leases.xml
 ```

- Add widget through OPNsense dashboard GUI
